title: Add a float parameter to an existing plugin
prompt:
The plugin TinyGain (plugins/TinyGain) already has one parameter, "gain". Add a second float parameter:

- ID: "drive", display name "Drive"
- range 0.0 to 1.0, default 0.0

Requirements:
1. Declare it in TinyGainAudioProcessor::createParameterLayout() next to "gain".
2. Read it in processBlock() through apvts.getRawParameterValue("drive") and use it (a simple soft-saturation amount is fine; exact DSP is not graded).
3. Document it in plugins/TinyGain/.ideas/parameter-spec.md.
4. Do not remove or rename the existing "gain" parameter.
5. Leave the project state consistent: `apc validate plugin --plugin TinyGain` must still pass.

No build is required; the work is graded statically.

checks.description: processBlock reads the parameter through the APVTS
the existing gain parameter is untouched
